# Tyre makers step up capacity expansion despite pressure on margins

Near-full capacity utilisation and resilient replacement and original-equipment demand are driving expansion, even as natural rubber and other input costs squeeze margins

Sohini Das Mumbai

India’s leading tyre manufacturers are accelerating capacity expansion despite facing a sharp decline in margins. This comes as strong replacement and original-equipment demand pushes utilisation at several plants close to peak levels.
